pairsWith.noteUz: Too/enough moslash va 1-9-unitlar takrori (Revision, 23 ta test).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 9-UNIT MAShQLAR, 5-BET + REVISION 1-9 (49-bet, PDF 48). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '9'.

CHAP USTUN:
15) 'Match column A to column B.' A: 1 Jim isn't fit enough 2 The Porsche is too expensive 3 The film was too boring 4 These boots aren't warm enough 5 The weather isn't windy enough 6 The questions were too difficult 7 David isn't brave enough 8 I'm too tired. B: a for me to wear in the winter. b to go sailing. c for me to buy. d to go shopping today. e to win the race. f to go into the haunted house. g for the children to watch. h for the students to answer. Namuna: 1 → e.
'Revision: Units 1 - 9':
16) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 Amanda ...... the laundry while Peter was cooking lunch. A doing B was doing C is doing. 2 ...... Ellen cycling to work when it started to rain? A Was B Were C Did. 3 What time does the boat to Sicily ......? A leaves B leave C leaving. 4 Jim ...... a book at the moment. A is reading B was reading C reads. 5 Ann has ...... reserved her train ticket. A yet B since C already. 6 Ed ...... been a plumber since 1995. A has B have C have had. 7 Your brother ...... you with the washing-up. A helping B will help C help. 8 Steve ...... to buy a new computer next week. A going B is going C goes.

O'NG USTUN:
9 Margo ...... to be a ballerina but now she's a dance instructor. A use B used C uses. 10 I ...... go to the library this morning. A didn't B haven't C don't. 11 Leslie is ...... taller than her sister. A much B more C most. 12 "Around the World in 80 days" was ...... by Jules Verne. A wrote B written C write. 13 Did you ...... to the theatre with Helen last night? A went B gone C go. 14 Has he ever ...... to Disneyland? A been B gone C go. 15 She has been a film director ...... she was 25 years old. A for B since C ever. 16 We had already ...... to bed by the time they came back. A gone B went C go. 17 She hasn't hung her clothes in the wardrobe ...... . A already B just C yet. 18 How long have they ...... waiting for you? A be B being C been. 19 I'd like ...... fresh tomato juice, please. A a few B some C much. 20 If it's chilly, we ...... home. A will stay B have stayed C stay. 21 John is an excellent pianist. He ...... practise hard. A can't B must C will. 22 This book is not as ...... as the one you gave me. A exciting B more exciting C most exciting. 23 Have you ever ...... your leg? A break B broke C broken.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '49'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match column A to column B. Example: 1 Jim isn't fit enough → e to win the race.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunni B ustunga moslang. Namuna: 1 Jim isn't fit enough → e to win the race.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOO / ENOUGH + TO-INFINITIV.

  1 isn't fit enough → e to win
    the race
  2 too expensive → c for me to
    buy
  3 too boring → g for the
    children to watch
  4 aren't warm enough → a for me
    to wear in the winter
  5 isn't windy enough → b to go
    sailing
  6 too difficult → h for the
    students to answer
  7 isn't brave enough → f to go
    into the haunted house
  8 too tired → d to go shopping
    today


⚠ 'A HAUNTED HOUSE':

  = arvohli uy.


⚠ 'TO GO SAILING':

  = yelkanli qayiqda suzmoq.

patterns.formula: KIM + isn't + SIFAT + enough + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Jim isn't fit enough to win the race. David isn't brave enough to go into the haunted house.
patterns.exampleUz: Jim poygada yutish uchun yetarlicha baquvvat emas. Devid arvohli uyga kirish uchun yetarlicha jasur emas.

patterns.formula: NIMA + is too + SIFAT + for + KIM + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: The Porsche is too expensive for me to buy. The questions were too difficult for the students to answer.
patterns.exampleUz: Porsche men sotib olishim uchun juda qimmat. Savollar talabalar javob berishi uchun juda qiyin edi.

patterns.formula: Have you ever + V3 + ...? / Has he ever been to ...?
patterns.exampleEn: Have you ever broken your leg? Has he ever been to Disneyland?
patterns.exampleUz: Hech qachon oyog'ingizni sindirganmisiz? U hech qachon Disneylendda bo'lganmi?
